high_level_description: The image is a split-screen of two nearly identical photos featuring the same person. The individual has long, dark brown hair that falls over their shoulders. They are wearing large, round black glasses and a black top with white polka dots. The person is also adorned with a delicate necklace with small, possibly rose gold, details. In both images, the person appears to be indoors, as suggested by the plain, light-colored wall in the background. The lighting is soft and natural, indicating it might be daytime.
